name: Claude
oneLiner: Research-journal warmth on stone with near-black ink and editorially strict contrast.

notes: The warm paper reduces effective contrast: keep body text at the full text role and never use the muted role for long copy.
Terracotta on paper is safe for 16px and up; below that, use the text role.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500

quiet.base: height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem

default.base: padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface)
padding-left: 20px; border-left: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--uiux-color-text)

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-full); background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-size: 0.75rem

do: Set body copy at a warm off-white and never at pure white — the paper tone is the identity.
Use the serif at ≥20px for headings and quotes only; labels and UI stay in the sans.
Keep one terracotta accent per screen, used for action and citation.
dont: Do not add shadows: separation comes from hairline borders and paper tone.
Do not use the serif for buttons, labels, or body copy.
Do not push the measure past 70 characters, even in wide layouts.
antiPatterns: Serif paragraphs in a dense dashboard.
Terracotta used as a background fill.
Cards floating on shadows above the paper.
